scope: Two recorded corrections: the missing negation in essay 06 under permission for small fixes, and the exact substantive revision in essay 20 explicitly approved by the author.

edits.before: “你不敢吃我。天帝命我统领百兽。你若吃我，就是违背天帝的命令。你若不信，我走在前面，你跟在后面，看看百兽见到我敢不敢逃。”
edits.after: “你不敢吃我。天帝命我统领百兽。你若吃我，就是违背天帝的命令。你若不信，我走在前面，你跟在后面，看看百兽见到我敢不敢不逃。”
edits.source_excerpt: 观百兽之见我而敢不走乎

edits.before: 他们没有直接命令婆罗门放下羊。
edits.after: 他们没有强行让婆罗门放下羊。
edits.authorization: The author explicitly approved this exact replacement after being asked whether to change the sentence to 他们没有强行让婆罗门放下羊。
edits.reason: Distinguish the absence of coercion from the absence of a spoken command; retain the earlier imperative and the following discussion of arranged choices.

en.before: They never directly order the Brahmin to put the goat down.

ko.before: 그들은 브라만에게 염소를 내려놓으라고 직접 명령하지 않았다.
